guidebook.intro: Comparing. Say “big over”: **Ewa amboa ti dria** (an elephant is bigger than a cow).

tips.title: … dria
body: **X amboa Y dria** (X is bigger than Y). **ndra dria** is the most: **Nde muke ndra dria** (this is the best).
**Ma le matooke dria ndra dria** (I like matooke most of all).

tips.title: Alu, ere
body: **Alu** (one) is the same, **ere** different: **Eri alu ku!** (it’s not the same!).
**ndi** is like: **Eri ovu eri andre ndi** (she looks like her mother).

culture.title: Comparing in proverbs
body: Many proverbs compare: health is worth more than wealth, and wisdom more than strength.
